summary: eng/validate-github-immutable-execution-pins.fsx requires the tracked .github/workflows/*.yml set to equal the declared inventory. The declared inventory is the Q3 snapshot plus the kind=workflow documents in evidence/github-substrate-v2/gs2-06-7/execution-pins-extension.json, each with its exact sha256 and its external/local uses: references. An undeclared or edited workflow fails with 'workflow inventory is incomplete' or 'digest differs'. That failure only appears in the required bootstrap-recovery check and a coherent-execution partition, about 25 minutes into CI (PR #1052 lost a cycle this way). Before pushing any workflow change, run `dotnet fsi eng/validate-github-immutable-execution-pins.fsx` and append or rehash the extension entry. Precedent appends (#971, #995, #1052) needed no other registry. The validator's architecture tests git-clone into TMPDIR; on Home, set TMPDIR to a private disk path, because a full shared tmpfs produces spurious 'No space left on device' failures.
title: New Coordination workflows must be declared in the execution-pin extension
